description: After the events with Enki, which led to the death of Gilgamesh, the Princess of Kaiser became the mother of all Shapeshifters by accepting the spirit that clung to her. It was this spirit which later on showed her the tragic destinies of her descendants through a vision. Ninmah could have chosen to refuse the power of the spirit and side with her father. Thus, she would have refused to yield to the devouring passion that the gladiator instilled in her to respect the Kaiser’s will. Enki would have defied Gilgamesh in single combat. The battle would have raged on for days. The invincible Kaiser would have realized that he was going to lose, being too old, before this young and ardent fighter, and he would start to feel a new sensation: fear. However, the Princess would decide to intervene by attacking the gladiator who would have taken a fatal blow. Enki would have managed to survive and barely get away. On his part, Gilgamesh would strive to recognize his daughter as a powerful warrior. Nevertheless, the father and daughter would need to prepare themselves: the ancient gladiator would have decreed the most terrible of vengeances. Many years later, some soldiers would have reported that a strange army composed of soldiers that transform into ferocious beasts was advancing towards the Kingdom of Kaiser...
fusion: I possess my own strength! I don’t need the help of any spirit...
evolution: Father… I am ready to fight! We’ll kill this wicked Enki!
